$comment: Advisories knowingly shipped, each with a date it stops being acceptable. Checked by scripts/check-shipped-advisories.mjs — read its header for why the check audits what a consumer installs rather than this repo's own tree. Every entry needs package, advisory (a GHSA id, or "*" for every advisory on that package), reason, and expires. An acceptance without an expiry is a deletion with better manners, so the checker refuses one.
